---
name: Feature request
about: A vulnerability class, mode, or agent scanme doesn't support yet
title: "[FEATURE] "
labels: enhancement
---

**What's missing**

**Why it matters** (a real scenario where the gap bit you, if you have one)

**Which category**
- [ ] New vulnerability class for Audit Mode
- [ ] New mode entirely
- [ ] Agent compatibility (which agent?)
- [ ] Scanner integration (which scanner — does it emit SARIF?)
- [ ] Something in the finding store / report / dashboard
- [ ] Other

**Proposed approach**, if you have one — remember: anything that becomes a
"finding" needs to fit the proof-tier model (Tier 1 reproduced, Tier 2
traced, or it's not a finding). If your idea doesn't fit that model, say so
explicitly — that's useful signal too.
